key_values.interpretation: Lowland air temperature stayed above 0 C, while wind chill produced a small subzero load and the report text contains all three high-ground ice signals.

primary_gt.interpretation: Lowland air temperature stayed above 0 C, while wind chill produced a small subzero load and the report text contains all three high-ground ice signals.

criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with the five requested numeric fields and one concise interpretation sentence.
criteria.name: JSON response shape
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for readable JSON with one missing numeric field or a verbose but still relevant interpretation; award at most 1 point if the response is not machine-readable.

criteria.description: Computes lowland freezing load as 0.0 C-hours and does not imply a lowland subzero air-temperature interval.
criteria.name: Air-temperature freezing ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for recognizing no lowland air-temperature freezing even if the C-hour formula is omitted; award 1 point for using the right formula with a minor threshold or rounding error.

criteria.description: Computes the minimum-temperature anomaly as about -5.7 C relative to 10 C and the duration at or below 5 C as 14 hours.
criteria.name: Cold-threshold ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for either the correct anomaly or the correct duration; award 3 points if both are conceptually correct but one is slightly outside tolerance.

criteria.description: Computes wind-chill freezing load near 4.1 C-hours from the hourly temperature and wind-speed series.
criteria.name: Wind-chill ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for applying wind chill and identifying subzero wind-chill exposure with a small arithmetic or rounding error; award at most 1 point for treating wind chill as air temperature.

criteria.description: Scores freezing-rain, icing, and slippery/icy-road text flags as 1 + 1 + 1 = 3.
criteria.name: Report-coded ice score
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for finding two of the three report-coded high-ground ice indicators or for the right total with unclear flag accounting.

criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation tied to the computed fingerprint rather than adding loss estimates, broad event narrative, or guidance.
criteria.name: Computed interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a mostly correct but over-broad interpretation; award no credit for guidance, loss claims, or a generic cold-wave summary not tied to the computed fields.
